app.name: Vukem Marketplace
app.tagline: Buy and sell anything, from shops all over Brazil.

home.hero_body: Free shipping on thousands of products, PIX or card, and buyer protection on every order.

footer.rights: © {year} Vukem Marketplace. A demo built with the vukem Go framework.
footer.not_affiliated: Not affiliated with any other marketplace.

admin.title: Admin
admin.intro: Moderation, payouts and the ledger arrive in the admin phase.

flags.title: Feature flags
flags.intro: Turn features on or off for everyone. Changes apply within seconds and every change is logged below.
flags.locked_error: This flag is locked and cannot be changed.

email_verification.label: Email verification
email_verification.description: New accounts must confirm their email before checkout, selling and the admin area, and get a verification email. Off: sign-up lands logged in with no email. Admins with an unverified email must verify it to keep using this page.

two_factor.label: Two-factor authentication for users
two_factor.description: Users may turn on an authenticator app. Off: no new enrolments (admins excepted); people who already use it keep it.

admin_two_factor.label: Two-factor authentication for admins
admin_two_factor.description: The admin area always requires two-factor authentication. It protects every admin action, so it cannot be turned off here.

google_login.label: Continue with Google
google_login.description: Shows the Google button on the login and sign-up pages (when Google credentials are configured) and serves its sign-in routes.

card_checkout.label: Card payments
card_checkout.description: Offers card payments (Stripe) at checkout when Stripe is configured. Payments already started still complete.

pix_checkout.label: PIX payments
pix_checkout.description: Offers PIX payments (AbacatePay) at checkout when AbacatePay is configured. Payments already started still complete.

graphql_api.label: GraphQL API
graphql_api.description: Serves /graphql for API key holders. Off: the endpoint answers 404; REST and gRPC are unaffected.

keys.title: API keys
keys.intro: Use an API key to call the REST, GraphQL and gRPC APIs from your own scripts. Each key only does what its scopes allow.
keys.name: Name
keys.name_hint: Something that tells you where the key is used, like "Inventory script".
keys.created_body: This is the only time "{name}" is shown. Store it in a password manager or a secret store; if you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.
keys.empty: No keys yet. Create one above to start calling the API.
keys.revoke_confirm: Revoke "{name}"? Anything using it stops working immediately.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: We will email you a link to choose a new one.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.body: We sent a link to {email}. Open it to verify your address.

two_factor.title: Two-factor authentication
two_factor.on: Two-factor authentication is on: logging in asks for a code from your authenticator app.
two_factor.store_codes: Store these recovery codes somewhere safe.
two_factor.store_codes_body: Each one works once if you lose your device; they are not shown again.
two_factor.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the setup key by hand, then type the code it shows.
two_factor.intro: Add a second step to your login: a code from an authenticator app on your phone.
two_factor.unavailable: Two-factor authentication is turned off for now. If you already use it, it stays on.

challenge.title: Two-factor authentication
challenge.enter_code: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
challenge.enter_recovery: Enter one of your recovery codes.
challenge.use_app: Use a code from your authenticator app
challenge.use_recovery: Lost your device? Use a recovery code

profile.title: My account
profile.heading: Profile
profile.password_hint: Only needed to change your email.
profile.unverified: Your email is not verified yet.
profile.security: Security: password, two-factor authentication and sessions

security.title: Security
security.two_factor_off: Off. We recommend turning it on.
security.sessions_body: Log out of every other browser and device signed in to your account. Remembered logins are forgotten too.
